summary: Round 1 had no blocking findings. Fix commit a9117d4 replaces `sudo install -m 0644 ... /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99-ci-network` with `sudo tee -a /etc/apt/apt.conf < tools/ci/apt-network.conf > /dev/null`. Input is still the repo-tracked file tools/ci/apt-network.conf (no ${{ }} expressions, env, or event data interpolated); the shell redirection is performed by the unprivileged runner user reading a repo file, and only tee runs as root writing a fixed path. Trigger is unchanged (no pull_request_target), so a PR author who could alter the conf already controls the workflow and has passwordless sudo on the ephemeral runner: no new privilege. Appending to an existing root-owned 0644 file keeps its ownership/mode, so the 0644 guarantee of the old step is preserved. The conf content is unchanged and only sets Acquire timeouts/retries; it does not weaken apt signature or TLS verification. Test change only adds diagnostic output from apt-config dump (non-secret). README change is documentation. No new dependencies, secrets, or randomness.
